measurements.seoul_portal_probe_2026_11_04: NEW PUBLISHER PROBED (2026-11-04 East Asia tick, all anonymous, plain HTTP): Seoul Open Data Plaza data.seoul.go.kr - a different publisher from the two parked national portals, and the Korea-access picture is NOT uniform. (1) Access: homepage and per-dataset pages answer plain HTTP 200 with full server-rendered metadata (data.seoul.go.kr/ 99,650 B; datasetView.do for OA-23105 75,723 B; the catalog list pages are AJAX shells - datasetList.do renders nav only and datasetSearchList.do rejected guessed params, so catalog enumeration needs the supported browser, next tick's probe). (2) LICENCE, from the dataset's own page (the publisher's instrument, not a portal-wide policy): the metadata block states copyright holder=Seoul Metropolitan Government, third-party rights=none, and use-permission scope: '이용허락범위: 공공누리 0유형 : 자유이용 (출처미표기)' (Korean Public Nuri Type 0: free use, attribution NOT required) - i.e. the most permissive Korean public-data licence, CC0-equivalent for our triage (class A), read verbatim on the page; a second variant on the same page reads '이용제한없음 : 자유이용' (no usage restrictions). Per-dataset licence fields must be re-read for any specific dataset taken forward. (3) File downloads are JS-mediated: the page posts form fields (infId, infSeq, seq) to datafile.seoul.go.kr/bigfile/iot/inf/nio_download.do; naive parameterised POSTs are rejected with a Korean alert '잘못된 접근입니다. 파일 목록에서 다시 선택하세요' (invalid access, re-select from the file list) - one changed retry with Referer+cookie failed the same way; the supported browser is the construction path for bulk files, and each page also renders an on-page sheet preview (<=1,000 rows) plus an Open API that requires an 인증키 (personal key), consistent with the KOSIS/KMA pattern. Commands retained: probe_kr_seoul_2026_11_04.py in this dir.

Coverage statement: 3 keyword families + the newest-items browse of 6,537; NOT a full catalog sweep.

rejection_reason: Parked on access: South Korea's two main national sources have no anonymous programmatic path. KOSIS's OpenAPI requires a personal signup + API key (인증키 신청), and KMA's data portal requires membership with PII (e-mail, name, phone number). Anonymous web-table downloads exist on KOSIS but scraping the web UI is not a documented API - a fragile construction path the pipeline does not take. No task was probed; the licence itself is clean (KOSIS explicitly permits redistribution with attribution for domestic statistics).
